programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E06 - Operation Bitterroot
programme.desc: Montana's Game Wardens have their hands full on the first day of big game season. Tag along as they check out the Bitterroot game area. And to nab poachers, they've got a clever sting operation going, using a mobile decoy.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E08 - End of the Line
programme.desc: While Chris hears the bull getting closer, he can't spot it. Casey, however, has a clear view. They attempt to communicate with hand signals, but the bull vanishes over the mountain, out of sight.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent
programme.desc: Explore the unspoilt mountains of Lapland and on to the pristine Swiss Alps. In contrast we then travel to Champagne Province in France - home of the finest wines in the world. Finally, Gibraltar beckons with its long history and strange mysterious caves.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E11 - Naturally Different
programme.desc: The Shetland Islands: home to 20,000 humans, one million birds and the smallest horse in the world. Then on to an area known to the locals as the Centre of the World in South Eastern province of Kazakhstan. From there we will go to the Yellow Mountains in Central China often called The Venice of China.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E13 - Barbados and Lake Como
programme.desc: Barbados has it all. Home to The Cliff, one of the world’s most famous restaurants where sharks swim in the floodlit bay and entertain diners. Considered by many to be the best of the Caribbean Islands it is home to media moguls and pop princesses alike. Italy’s Lake Como also plays host to a number of famous Hollywood stars and directors who’ve fallen in love with its breath-taking vistas and fabulous cuisine.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E01 - Chiang Mai and Eze
programme.desc: Nestled in the foothills of northern Thailand, Chiang Mai is the country’s fifth largest city. Brimming with culture, beautiful architecture and stunning temples it’s often considered a sanctuary away from Bangkok. In the South of France, nestled between Nice and Monte Carlo is the picture postcard town of Eze.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E12 - The Last Hunters
programme.desc: Arctic Pt3. The Inuit take Jim and Corey on their last adventure together. Jim finds inspiration from empty stretches of broken ice and the people who live off it.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: 10 Inch Hero
programme.desc: An artist gets a job at a beachside sandwich shop, where she hangs out with a techie, a flirt, a rocker, a hippie, and a Wiccan.

programme.title: Alien Trespass
programme.desc: After crash landing on the outskirts of a desert town, an alien enlists the help of a local waitress to recapture a monster that has escaped the wreckage of his spaceship in this affectionate, knowing, hilarious send-up of a genreís sillier past.

programme.title: Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Ensemble drama about conversations overheard in a bistro: two chess players see unfolding dramas, a couple on an uncomfortable blind date, a crumbling marriage, and film-noir fans that think they're witnessing a real-life murder.

programme.title: Citizen Duane
programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: Comedy Meets Classic
programme.desc: Created by British comedy duo Carrington-Brown, based in Berlin, and Irish conductor ClA�odhna NA� AodA�in, based in Switzerland. They join forces with "The Swonderful Orchestra" for this exciting, classy, and hilarious music & comedy show.

programme.title: Flirting With Flamenco
programme.desc: When Sylvia's well-meaning dad (Watt) surprises her with a devastating revelation, Sylvia's world is turned upside down. But will she crumble or prove herself at the local flamenco contest? An uplifting feel-good Brit comedy drama, Flirting with Flamenco will have you laughing, crying and feeling empowered to turn your life around.

programme.title: Citizen Duane
programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: The Flying Deuces
programme.desc: When two bumbling friends join the French Foreign Legion on a whim, they find themselves in a whirlwind of misadventures, love, and laughter as they attempt to navigate the challenges of military life in a foreign land.

programme.title: Perfect Girl
programme.desc: A coming of age romance for anyone who's ever had a crush. Since high school, Stan and Jenny have had crushes on each other. They wrote letters to one another over school holidays but in person they barely spoke; sharing only the occasional lingering glance and smile. Over the years they fantasized about how perfect they would be as lovers. Ten years later they bump into each other and have the chance to make it a reality, but it's not that simple; self doubt, fear of rejection, of losing their fantasies will hold them back from what could be the perfect union.

programme.title: I Would Have Kissed You
programme.desc: Three months after college graduation, best friends Mattie and Olivia are struggling to write a feature and struggling even more with their love lives. Mattie finds herself in a grey area with her college ex-boyfriend while Olivia clings to the hope that her crush will finally want to be with her (despite his hot new girlfriend.) British Web Awards - Awarded "Best Writing in a Dramedy" and "Best Music" Top Indie Awards -Awarded "Best Humor" WRPN Women's International Film Festival - Awarded "Exceptional Merit Award"

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: When Union spies steal Johnnie Gray's (Buster Keaton) beloved locomotive, the General, he pursues them with the aid of his fiance, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack) straight through enemy lines. One of the most revered comedies of the silent era.

programme.title: Finding Joy
programme.desc: A struggling writer rediscovers himself, his offbeat family, and what it means to be happy when he meets Joy – a spirited, possibly-dying young woman who asks him to write her obituary.

programme.title: Brazzy Jazzy
programme.desc: When a Brazilian Girl takes on the NYC fashion world, her adventures are sometimes sexy, often funny but always Caffeinated! It's Jane the Virgin meets Girls, only an outsider immigrant version - more like Girls of the 3rd World.

programme.title: Growing Op
programme.desc: In an average American neighborhood, a family of four breaks all conformity making it difficult for their 18 year old son to fit in to society.

programme.title: 30 Nights of Sex
programme.desc: In a last ditch effort to save their marriage, Nick and Willa visit a renowned, yet eccentric, couples therapist and embark on a month-long journey of provocative and hilarious sex assignments.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Sailing Team
programme.desc: A picture perfect photo opportunity turns nearly tragic in a flash. A young boy is home alone when two intruders break in to his house. Racing in the Gulf of Mexico puts a sailing team in deep trouble. And our moral dilemma looks at the lure of internet gambling.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Avalanche
programme.desc: A snowmobile rider goes mountain climbing and starts an avalanche. * We revisit the Mount St. Helen eruption site and hear from those who survived the volcano. * A house boat gets stuck on a dam on the Kentucky River. * A woman kayaker is pinned against a rock in a rapid. Will she survive?

programme.title: Whaddyado - Athlete Collapses
programme.desc: A boy catches fire and a young onlooker has what it takes to tackle the situation. * An athlete collapses in the weight room and a race against the clock begins trying to revive him. * A moral dilemma segment examines an inappropriate teacher-student relationship.

programme.title: ChatRoom - Self Cutting
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: She’s taken control of their relationship and now things are out of control. And your friend seems to be intentionally injuring herself. How would you handle it?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Dad's Dating
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: Her boyfriend is all hands and it’s making her uncomfortable. Also, mom died and now dad’s dating – how do you feel about it?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Teacher / Student
programme.desc: ChatRoom focuses on the ever-changing issues for today’s teens in a format that invites viewers to listen in on the conversation. This week’s topics include: What are the implications when a teacher makes a pass at a student? And “Sexting” sounds exciting but there’s a lot to consider before you hit send.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Brazil
programme.desc: The South American country of Brazil serves as the backdrop for our adventures this week. On day one we experience Avorismo, a trip that begins with tree climbing and ends with a splash. Day two starts with Olodum, a Brazilian percussion session that we beat like a drum and we take in Projeto Tamar to learn all about the varieties of sea turtles that call Brazil home. We shake things up on day three as we learn how to dance the samba then visit the city and experience the culture of Salvador, Bahia. We finish our adventures by training in the Brazilian martial art of Capoeria and leave things up in the air as we try our hand at juggling.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Quebec
programme.desc: On this week’s show we’ll visit Quebec City, Quebec. First, we’ll visit the Citadel and experience what it’s like to be a cadet. Then we’re off to learn all there is to know about maple sugaring. Next, we go on a bee safari and discover things we didn’t know about bees. Then, we’ll try yachting. To wrap up the show, we have some fun go-carting.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Las Vegas
programme.desc: This week’s “Awesome Adventure” takes place in the city of Las Vegas. We’ll attempt a unique type of skydiving…one that takes place indoors. Then we’ll head outdoors taking to the sky in some old fashioned WW II biplanes. We’ll visit the world famous Hoover Dam and then we’ll meet up with some circus folk and learn a few tricks of the trade. Finally, we’ll visit Lake Mead for a jet skiing adventure, and the Valley of Fire for some four wheelin’ fun.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Powerful Predators
programme.desc: This show is dedicated to some of the world’s most powerful predators- from sharks in the Gulf of Mexico, to eagles and wolves in Minnesota. We’ll also explore the controversial topic of whether large predators should be kept in captivity in places like Zoo’s and SeaWorld.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Canned Hunting
programme.desc: Come visit a college in southern California that teaches courses like Exotic Animal Training to prospective animal trainers. Then, look at the gruesome, but legal sport of canned hunting. And don’t forget that many victims of natural disasters are animals, often left behind to fend for themselves or perish. Now, the Humane Society offers to help pets in need when disaster strikes. Finally we’ll see the Shambala preserve, a haven for endangered, exotic big cats.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Yellowstone
programme.desc: This week we’ll travel to Yellowstone National Park and visit the animals that inhabit this national wonder. We’ll also meet photographers Russ Finley and Tom Murphy, who make a living out in the wild. Then learn more about the dog’s canine cousins the wolf and the coyote.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Car Fire
programme.desc: A routine trip to visit some relatives literally takes a turn for the worse. *A trooper arrives on the scene of a car fire and someone’s trapped inside the burning vehicle. *A young man’s car is immobilized by rapidly rising water and he can’t open the door.*A woman pulls into her driveway and catches a burglar in the act.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Car Fall
programme.desc: A car falls on a man’s chest and his teenage nephew must find the strength to help solve this weighty problem and save his uncle’s life. * A bicycle brake impales a young boy’s leg and the resulting wound is more serious than anyone thought. * A moral dilemma segment deals with how to handle a stalker.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Kitchen Fire
programme.desc: * The son of a firefighter proves he can stand the heat in a kitchen on fire.* A young girl pulls off a great escape when she fights off an ex-con trying to abduct her. * This week we take a closer look at the alarming trend of cutting or self-injury among teens

programme.title: ChatRoom - Stalking
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: Someone is stalking you. How do you handle it? And what happens if you don’t get into the college of your choice?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Cyber Bully
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: A coach who takes motivation to the extreme. And cyber bullying is becoming more and more common. What can you do about it?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Bad Mother
programme.desc: This week’s topics include: He seems familiar, but will he take them for a ride? And Mom makes an offer that could change the whole party. Is she a cool mom or a poor parent? If teens are thinking about it or feeling it, we’re discussing it, in the ChatRoom.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Islands
programme.desc: On this week’s “Awesome Adventures,” we’ll travel to the Bahamas to watch a trained troop of flamingos, visit an 18th century fort, and learn how to make a traditional Bahamian dish. We’ll experience the adventure of a lifetime as we venture into shark-infested waters. Then we’ll learn all about sailing as we hit the open waters.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Bundle up because this week Nicole explores Iceland for a few days of winter!

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Thailand
programme.desc: This week we head to Southeast Asia to spend time in Phuket, Thailand.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Best of 1996
programme.desc: This episode features the best of 1996/1997 season. From the underwater world of the Great Barrier Reef to the Serengeti in Africa, visit the extraordinary places and animals highlighted in this presentation of “Wild About Animals.”

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Alaska Raven
programme.desc: On this episode of “Wild About Animals,” we’ll watch as one man wrestles alligators for a living. We’ll go to Anchorage, Alaska to find out the truth about the mysterious raven. Then, we’ll look at a sport for dogs that requires athletic ability and teamwork that some say is the ultimate game of fetch. The sport is called flyball, and all kinds of dogs just love it. And we’ll visit a place that rescues, rehabilitates and releases injured seals and sea lions.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Support Animals
programme.desc: Join Emmy Award-winning Actress, Mariette Hartley, as she travels the globe to bring viewers fascinating stories!

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - St. Louis
programme.desc: We march to the Arch and take in the sights and sounds of St. Louis. Day one starts with Glide St. Louis, a tour of the city on segway personal transporters and we literally bounce off the walls at Sky Zone for a unique brand of dodgeball. On day two we stopped by Adrenaline Zone to play something called Demolition Ball then we practiced with the Arch rival Roller Girls who introduced us to the toughest sport on four wheels. Day three began with a close encounter of the insect kind at the Sophia M. Sachs Butterfly House and we experienced a place like no other called the City Museum. Our final day is highlighted by racing around at NASCAR Speed Park and the Challenger Learning Center for an uplifting experience.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Jamaica
programme.desc: On this episode we’ll visit the gorgeous island of Jamaica. We’ll visit some waterfalls and go cliff jumping. Then we’ll have some more fun in the water, but this time on horses. Next, we’ll experience our design talents making pottery, and get the taste of some real Caribbean jerk chicken.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Aspen
programme.desc: On this week’s “Awesome Adventures,” we’ll visit America’s winter wonderland—Aspen, Colorado. We’ll meet and learn about some special dogs who rescue skiers trapped in avalanches. Then if off paragliding over the majestic Rocky Mountains as we touch down on the slopes for some skiing and tubing, not to mention an exciting snow shoe tour of the mountains.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Miniature Petting Zoo
programme.desc: In this show, we'll see how a miniature petting zoo is a good way to introduce children to wildlife. This zoo includes a miniature Scottish highlander cow. Then we'll go to Alaska where huge brown bears hunt for salmon and a mother grizzly bear nurses her cubs. We'll visit a Badlands museum in South Dakota that features skeletons of mammals that once lived 30 million years ago. And we'll travel to Scottsdale, Arizona where an animal refuge center features mountain lions, bobcats and kit foxes.

And finally we’ll travel to the Bronx where lots of dogs turned out for the ultimate pooch picnic in the park.

programme.title: 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu - 20 Years in Orbit
programme.desc: Discover the pivotal moments that defined 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu's journey, a revolutionary evolution to the art of Jiu Jitsu that forever changed the landscape of martial arts that continues to shape the world of grappling. Join us as we celebrate this momentous anniversary, paying homage to the visionaries and pioneers who propelled this art form to new heights. Don't miss this must-watch documentary that will leave you inspired and in awe of the remarkable journey of 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu.

programme.title: American Grappling - Seattle
programme.desc: American Grappling heads to Seattle, Washington. Coach Morgan heads to the world-famous Pike’s Market and get a taste of the Northwest. Our featured competitor is the black belt Nathan Orchard. Nathan is looking to make Team USA to tick the final box of his career…win a grappling world championship…but he’ll have to get past Eric Spence. Eric has wrestled his whole life and competed on a wrestling US World team. It’s the traditional clash of styles between wrestling and jiujitsu. Find out who’ll end up on top and secure their spot at the world team trials.

programme.title: American Grappling - St. Louis
programme.desc: On this episode of American Grappling, the Qualifiers for 2024 have officially started ! This episode we see what talent the midwest has to offer with the Qualifiers being hosted in St Louis. Experience the city, the people and of course grappling as the USA Grappling team begin to build their new team for the World Championships. Directed, shot and edited by Anthony Kadel Produced by The Grappling Network

programme.title: American Grappling Podcast- Ft. Dr. Ivan Rascon Aguilar
programme.desc: In this Episode of the AGF Podcast, Brandon Quick interviews Gastroenterologist Ivan Rascon - Aguilar, MD about the health benefits of the Carnivore Diet, how its changed Brandon’s life and how Dr. Rascon - Aguilar is helping hundreds reverse preventable diseases and how a dietary and lifestyle change can improve wellness and athletic performance. Keep an eye out for more American Grappling Federation content here on The Grappling Network.

programme.title: BJJ Classics - Grapplers Quest West Coast
programme.desc: Grapplers Quest was founded in 1996 and began the submission grappling fever throughout the martial arts world and set Grapplers Quest as the premiere submission grappling event. Check out these old school No Gi matches featuring UFC Champion B.J. Penn taking on Mike Cardoso- ADCC U.S. Trials Champion. Pioneering athletes like Marc Laimon, Dean Lister, Jeff ""Snowman"" Monson, Chris Brennan, Tony Desouza, Alexandre Dantas, Homer Moore, Alberto Crane, J.D. Penn, Garth Taylor and Sean Spangler. Don't miss the event that started a legacy in the sport of submission grappling and revoltionized ground fighting in the martial arts world."

programme.title: BJJ Classics - Grappling All-Stars
programme.desc: Grappling All Stars is a collection of the world's best grapplers in action on the mat from the OTM archives. Featuring; Renner Gracie, BJ Penn, Diego Sanchez, Jeff Glover, Dean Lister, and many more!

programme.title: BJJ Classics - Submissions 101 Chapter 2
programme.desc: Submissions 101 Chapter 2 features the top grapplers showing you their best setups and submissions. A new feature in this sequel includes submissions broken down into categories which include: arm attacks, chokes, leg attacks, triangles, and other attacks. These old school matches are a great learning tool for anyone beginning their submission training or advanced grapplers looking to add new tools to their game. 101 Submissions Chapter 2 includes over 1 year of competition footage from around the world compressed into 48 minutes of intense action from the greatest events in the globe.

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 6
programme.desc: This Episode features technique breakdowns of Ryan Hall, Kron Gracie, Jeremiah Vance, Cora Sek, and Jon 'Thor' Blank.

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 7
programme.desc: This episode includes breakdowns of Clark Gracie's and Baret Yoshida's Crucifixes, Nathan Orchard's signature move, The Dead Orchard and Marcelo Garcia's arm drag.

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 8
programme.desc: This Episode breaks down the double buggy choke from 10pQ 19, Geo Martinez's twister, Genki Sudo's flying triangle, and Tarik Hopstock's Tarikoplata.

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 9
programme.desc: This episode breaks down Keenan Cornelius' Reverse Omoplata, Craig Jones' Inside Sankaku, Lachlan Giles' heel hook attacks and Grace “The Silent Assassin” Gundrum.

programme.title: Black Sheep Boxing with Zack Moore - 10pATX
programme.desc: After struggling with addiction himself, Jeff Meadows opened Black Sheep Boxing along with his friend Sky Wood with the purpose of giving recovering addicts an opportunity to turn their lives around. programme.desc: Steev Letts has performed at Just for Laughs VANCOUVER and the Grindstone Comedy Festival, and his debut album Burger Queen is available online.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: Sir Patrick Stewart: A Knight of Comedy
programme.desc: Sir Patrick Stewart, Knight of the Realm, brings all the wit, elegance, and gravitas you’d expect from a British thespian to the Just For Laughs stage. He’s a former member of the Royal Shakespeare Company and a fictional Star Ship captain, marking the first time a bona fide knight in shining armour has hosted a Just For Laughs gala. Join Sir Patrick for a star-studded evening of comedy, featuring the hilarious Sebastian Maniscalco, Gina Yashere, Russell Howard, Jim Breuer, and Pete Zedlacher.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Chris Robinson: Panning for Gold

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Cheech & Chong : Puff Puff Laugh
programme.desc: The inventors of stoner comedy, legends Cheech & Chong are still jokin’ (and possibly smokin’). Catch them as they perform some of their funniest bits, recall some hilarious behind-the-scenes stories from their days of filming ‘Up In Smoke’ and host a full bag of the world’s funniest comedians. Included in the special are Last Comic Standing finalist Lavell Crawford, creator and star of the Brit cult comedy The Mighty Boosh Noel Fielding, the ever-opinionated Bill Burr, and Canada’s own rising star Jay Malone.

programme.title: Decline of the American Empire
programme.desc: Hosted by The Daily Show’s favourite Brit correspondent John Oliver, The Decline of the American Empire is the comedy dissection of our neighbours to the South… sort of a hilarious outsider’s State of the Union. It’s the smartest, most opinionated and politically-fuelled show in the lineup show, so get ready to piss your political trousers, speak your mind and have a look at the future, or lack thereof, of the USA.

programme.title: Night of One Million Opinions
programme.desc: Never the introvert, the Angriest Man in America Lewis Black hosts a roster of opinionated comics who just want to be heard, dammit! Along with Lewis spewing his usual bile about the state of everything, Derek Edwards pontificates on his driving frustrations, Dom Irrera thinks alcohol is wonderful, Kathleen Madigan has lost all hope for America, Greg Giraldo rants on about how women have all the power today, and Paul F Tompkins has probably the most incendiary topic of all. You’d be an idiot to miss it… then again, that’s just our opinion.

programme.desc: Gabby and Jono try their luck in panoramic Salt Lake City, Utah.

programme.title: Lucky in Love - Lucky in Love Ep 3
programme.desc: Percy and Michelle go on a game of chance in the Emerald city of Seattle.

programme.desc: The Ellis Family explores Washington D.C., discovering monuments, Ford’s Theatre, and the best cupcakes in the capital!

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation - Ellis Family Vacation: Grand Canyon
programme.desc: The Ellis Family road trips to the Grand Canyon and Zion National Park in search of some outdoor fun.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation - Ellis Family Vacation: New Orleans
programme.desc: The Ellis Family ventures to the Big Easy, soaking up the culture of New Orleans with jazz, beignets, airboat adventures, and more.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation - Ellis Family Vacation: Birmingham
programme.desc: The Ellis Family checks out Birmingham, Alabama, ground zero of the Civil Rights Movement, visiting museums, monuments, and locations that helped end segregation in the United States.

programme.title: Soul of The South - Soul of The South
programme.desc: Join writer and photographer Johny Pitts as he journeys along the Civil Rights Trail through the American South. From Tennessee to Mississippi to Alabama, discover the people and the places, the music, food, and culture, linked to this pivotal period in world history.

programme.title: Paul & Nick's Big American Food Trip - Paul & Nicks Big American Food Trip: Philadelphia 1
programme.desc: Paul and Nick meet with Colin Brooks of the 1718 project, founded to investigate the historical links between Ulster, Scotland and Philadelphia. They also cook for Randall Redman, who claims to be able to trace his ancestry to Robert The Bruce.

programme.title: Paul & Nick's Big American Food Trip - Paul & Nicks Big American Food Trip: Philadelphia 2
programme.desc: Philadelphia was one of the main entry ports for immigrants to America in the 18th century. Paul and Nick meet Drew McGinty and Joyce Alexander, the founder of the Center for Ulster-Scots Studies. Our chefs try to cook an Ulster-Scots meal, but keep being seduced by Italian fare.

programme.desc: Step off the beaten path and connect to your inner trailblazer in this cross-country journey to some of the most beautiful but little-known landscapes of North America.

programme.desc: Relive the golden age of Hollywood.

programme.title: Get Out of Town - Sunshine State of Mind - Orlando, Florida
programme.desc: Orlando can be a gateway to all sorts of surprising adventures.

programme.title: United States of Sports - United States of Sports
programme.desc: Copa90’s Eli and Timbsy and Love Island’s Josh Denzel go on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip. Then, the guys hit the Midwest for an unforgettable road trip through Detroit, Chicago and Cincinnati.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Paddling Juneau, Alaska
programme.desc: Ken Whiting travels to Juneau, Alaska to paddle with whales, bears, glaciers and icebergs on a multi-day sea kayaking adventure.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Paddling St. Louis
programme.desc: Ken Whiting tests his canoe and stand up paddle boarding skills on the rivers around St. Louis, Missouri

programme.title: Adventure Cities - AdventureCities: Lexington, Scottsdale, Lafayette
programme.desc: Travel writer Jonathan Thompson sets out to explore the adventurous sides of Scottsdale, Arizona, Lafayette, Louisiana & Lexington, Kentucky.

programme.title: Destination Route 66 - Destination Route 66: Roadside Attractions
programme.desc: Route 66 is lined with wonderful and informative attractions. Here are just a few of those must-see stops!

programme.title: USA Through Film - USA Through Film 2
programme.desc: Actor and director Jordan Spiro (Ozark, Night Comes On) spent childhood vacations with her family in New Orleans. For Spiro, the city’s heritage as the birthplace of jazz is reflected in its mélange of arts and food culture that always feels fresh, inviting, and joyous, even after a lifetime of visits. “There’s this ‘all senses on overload’ side to New Orleans that takes my breath away every time.”

programme.title: Beach Battles - Beach Battles: Coney Island & Manitowoc
programme.desc: Coney Island, New York hosts its annual Mermaid Parade, and sand sculpting pros battle in Manitowoc, Wisconsin.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story - Small Town Big Story: Man Vs. Train
programme.desc: For over 50 years, bikers from around the world have gathered in Colorado to race the Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad Train through the Rocky Mountains, over two mountain passes.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story - The Town Chicken Dinner Built
programme.desc: The Town Chicken Dinner Built

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story - Small Town Big Story: Where the Highland Games Come Home - Banner Elk, NC
programme.desc: Just two hours north of Charlotte, Banner Elk offers a wide array of year-around activities for outdoor enthusiasts, but is most well known for their annual Highland Games, one of the largest celebrations of Scottish culture and tradition anywhere in the world.

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - Tying the Knot at 13,000 Feet
programme.desc: A romantic trip to Colorado takes a windy turn when Jason pushes Tayler, despite her hesitation, to summit Mt. Democrat in 70 mph winds and -19 degree weather.

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - A Newly-Wed Recipe for Disaster
programme.desc: Jason loves mountain biking. Tayler prefers to read a book. Jason is up for any adventure tossed at him. Tayler likes to be a bit more prepared. Will the adventures that await in Arkansas leave the couple questioning if they have anything in common?

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - Theodora's Room
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason travel to Eureka Springs, Arkansas, a town with a rich history and home to one of the most haunted hotels in America, The Crescent. Jason convinces Tayler to stay one night, but will that stay lead to a night they don't want to remember?

programme.title: COFFEE The Ultimate Language - COFFEE The Universal Language: Rogers
programme.desc: Rogers, Arkansas, is a vibrant city where rich history, and a thriving arts scene converge. ​In this episode Andrea Allen, US Barista Champion, Visits 2 woman owned shops roasting and serving Rogers in a big way.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI - Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI - Amplify USVI: Roots & Rhythms: The Foundations of St. Croix Music
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI - Amplify USVI: Sound of Revolution: Music as a Voice for Change
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas uncovers the revolutionary spirit woven into the music of St. Croix, where sound has long served as a rallying cry for justice and identity. Through the powerful perspectives of Mada Nile, Ras Attitude, Ras Bach, the Ay-Ay Cultural Dancers, and Kevin Williams, this episode explores how artists have used music to confront oppression, celebrate resilience, and inspire change — from the island’s historic struggles to its modern-day movements.

programme.title: Just Landed - Virginia Beach
programme.desc: Jim kicks off his journey in Virginia Beach, a coastal gem with a deep-rooted fishing heritage. But Mother Nature has her own plans—as storm clouds roll in, Jim has a challenge ahead: tagging his first Redfish for NOAA to help track its migration.

programme.title: Just Landed - Maine
programme.desc: Jim lands in Maine to meet the faces behind one of the top seafood scenes in the U.S. From Portland to North Haven, it’s all about experiencing true coastal life from the Mainers' point of view. Jim then checks off a bucket list moment: smallmouth fishing on the legendary Grand Lake.

programme.title: Cheat Meal - Cheat Meal: Virginia Beach, Part 1
programme.desc: Tyler and Monica head to Virginia Beach where they’re tasked by celebrity chef Cliff Crooks to create the ultimate cheat meal for a local restaurateur. Armed with the power of their taste buds, the dynamic duo checks out the best places to eat, including Oishii Burger, Chick’s Oyster Bar and Klassic Doughnuts, to build an off-the-charts meal of epic portions.

programme.title: Cheat Meal - Cheat Meal: Virginia Beach, Part 2

At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky - One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 447 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. First up, striker Bryen Dao takes on brawler Ferrin Marcelin in the featherweight division and Aiden Ingram steps into the cage with Steve Mora in a bantamweight bout. Also on this card Carlos Figueroa looks to break Artem Afanasenko's undefeated streak. In the main event, Christopher "Taco" Padilla puts his lightweight title on the line when he faces his toughest opponent yet with five time UFC veteran Justin Janyes.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 451 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off in the bantamweight division, Jonathan Powell steps into the cage with veteran grappler Will Holguin. In a featherweight bout, striker Jonny O'Neill takes on wrestler Eudardo Zarate with the winner moving on to a title opportunity. Also watch as Adam Garcia and Zachary Kraschinsky take to the ring in a lightweight bout. With two titles on the line in the featured bout, the rising star UNF Featherweight title and the California State featherweight title in the rising stars division, Stone Lavelle and his opponient Sean Crenshaw battle it out for the two belts.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 430- Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. Up first in the middle weight division Denis Ceausu faces Andrei Varga. In the open weight division with a huge weight differential Rodrigo Mineiro, kickboxing world champion takes on boxer Bogdan Bestea for a boxing versus kickboxing contest. Watch as Alex Leautaund of the Netherlands takes on Romania's Mihai Desrobitu in a cruiserweight boxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 433 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. First up, a Superfight in the welterweight division, Bogdan Floristean versus Ionel Balan. In the women's lightweight division Maria Nitescu takes on Andreea Cebuc to determine the Baddest Woman in Romania. Also on this episode in the open division Tibor Varga of Hungary steps into the ring with Romania's Bogdan Nastase in a David versus Goliath duel.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 437 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of boxing and kickboxing fights. In the welterweight division Vinicius Bereta takes on Valentin Mavrodin in a Brazil versus Romania bout. In the open weight division Tolea Ciumac steps into the ring with Valentin Lambagiu with 100 pounds and over 20 years difference between the two fighters for a David versus Goliath duel. In the main event, Portugal's Iuri Fernandes faces Romania's Bogdan Stoica, with a stunning 58 wins to his name, in the Heavyweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 453 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 2 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, California. Starting off with a female bout, undefeated fighters Olympian Brianda Cruz and Susana Lopez step into the ring to fight for their perfect record. In the main event is another battle of the undefeated as David Romero takes on Pedro Valencia who is coming off of a three year hiatus.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 411 - Clan Wars 50
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 50 from Belfast. Up first a lightweight title bout with Dara O'Sullivan versus Sam "Slam" Simon, Nathan Chambers squares off against Brian Damian in the featherweight division, Lewis Byrne faces Latvian Juris Ruckanovs and Mike McBride steps into the ring with Billy Sutherland in the Bantamweight division with a title on the line. In the main event for the Superlightweight title, Peter Halpenny takes on Jamie McCaugherty.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 446 - CMH Boxing I part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing I part 1. In this initial episode of Championing Mental Health Boxing, Marlen Avila faces the young and undefeated Poison Ivy Enriquez. Watch as Jose Ramirez steps into the ring with Jessie Mandapat looking for an upset. Also on this card, promising up and comer Jonny "Magic" Mansour is matched up against Christian Avalos who looks to end Jonny's undefeated streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 452 - CMH Boxing I part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing I part 2 from the Avalon in Hollywood. In the women's division, Brook Sibrian of California takes on the younger Rubi Gutierriz out of Mexico. In the co-main event, Victor Pisillas is set to meet the challenge with Carlos Jackson in a crossroads fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 450 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 1 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, Califorinia. Starting off the night, Adan Gonzales out of Denver takes to the ring in a southpaw matchup with Dedrick Crocklem of Seattle with a 3-0 record. Also on this card, Samuel Isak takes on Chris Pacheco making his pro-debut. Watch as veteran boxer Vaughn Alexander returns to the DMG ring from St. Louis to take on unstoppable Ruben Cazales with a record of 12-0 and 11 KO's in a super middleweight battle.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 371 - KOK Best Of Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Best of King of Kings part 2. In a boxing match Naglis Tamasevicius faces Juris Zundovskis. In a clash of the titans, heavyweight Martin Pacas is matched up against Turkey's Kadir Yildirim "The Terminator." Farshad Derekeh of the Netherlands and Latvian Reinis Porozovs take to the ring in a boxing bout and Beka Gabisonia faces Farruh Gafurov in the Mega Series.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 379 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 1 from London. Also faceing off are Tyrone Eliffe and Richard Samuels and George Taylor and Andrei Nastac take to the ring to battle it out in a heavyweight bare knuckle match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 380 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 2 from London. Watch as Kamil Sokolowski and Bri Morrow trade punches in a challenging matchup. programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 3 from London. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 258 - UFA Presents the Fighter's Only World MMA Awards XIII
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the 13th annual Fighter's Only 2021 World MMA Awards from Worre Studios in Las Vegas, hosted by Chael Sonnen. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 259 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 1. Young Estonian fighters Stanislav Teniugin and Siim Viljus battle under KOK Kickboxing rules. Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha

In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

programme.title: Dexter Jackson's Guide to Dating: The Movie
programme.desc: Everyone has had a lousy date in their lifetime. If not, then you were the bad date. See how Dexter navigates throughout the dating pool in this comedy about dating.

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Two young ministers at a local church are confronted with their moral failures. When tragedy strikes the truth becomes a mystery to solve.

programme.title: Set In The West: The Genesis of L.A. Hip Hop
programme.desc: The origins of Hip Hop emerging from New York City in the '70s are well documented, but many do not know there was another music scene that rose out of Los Angeles. This feature documentary tells the untold, rarely heard stories of the West Coast Hip Hop.

programme.title: Third Timothy
programme.desc: Two brothers travel door to door selling holy water throughout the rural South.

programme.title: Powder Fresh
programme.desc: "Powder Fresh" experimental look at grooming and hygienic practices.

programme.title: Til My Casket Drops
programme.desc: Watching his mother get killed as a kid turns Mayhem into a monster, who lives by the gun, determined to get rich by all means necessary, even if it means losing his life in pursuit of the almighty dollar.

programme.title: Friends like Sisters
programme.desc: Helen and Brenda grew up as friends like sisters and married into their dreams and nightmares, bringing broken trust and betrayal. Will faith and forgiveness fix shattered relationships?

programme.title: Nine Divine
programme.desc: A shy foster girl uses her amazing art skills and creative abilities to escape her traumatic life. But when her baby brother goes missing, she finds herself in a race against time to save him among rising concerns of her sanity.

programme.title: The Deliverance of Amy Stronghold
programme.desc: Amy Stronghold, a homeless hustler, must get off the streets, hold a job, move to the strange land of suburbia, and find God before her daughter is lost to her forever.

programme.title: Joyland
programme.desc: Pooda Johnson is celebrating his last weekend on house arrest with a kickback (party) that could jeopardize the very freedom he’s celebrating.

programme.title: Jimmy's Friends
programme.desc: After a five year stint in prison, Jimmy Tucker returns to the streets of Oakland to find his entire life destroyed and everyone else doing well. With zero prospects and nothing to his name, Jimmy only wants one thing: his cut from the heist.

programme.title: Pattern
programme.desc: A few months after the maternal death of his partner, a man is at a crossroads on how to raise their baby.

programme.title: Hypno
programme.desc: The lines are blurred between illusion and reality as a struggling writer takes on a psychological journey that lands himself caught between a mysterious love affair and unresolved issues from the past.

programme.title: Noxious 2: Cold Case
programme.desc: Years after the events of Noxious, our protagonist is on the run and her past is catching up with her.

programme.title: The Great Divide
programme.desc: At a monthly gathering of her friends, a student of the Tantra and Kama Sutra introduces an unusual game designed to elicit the feelings and impressions men and women have about one another.

programme.title: F*cking Married
programme.desc: LJ and Candice, get married overnight but before a judge can grant an annulment they are sentenced to live together for 30 days under the same roof.

programme.title: They’re Trying to Kill Us
programme.desc: Why do people of color suffer from disproportionately higher rates of chronic disease? From producers Chris Paul and Billie Eilish, this film investigates the link between diet, disease, poverty, racism, and corruption, unraveling what keeps us sick.

programme.title: Indifferent Enchantment
programme.desc: Separated party-goer and determined single mother, both indifferent about love, fall in love. Their enchanted relationship moves fast, and with no proper understanding of one another, they are left questioning if life's better apart.

programme.title: Sisters and The Shrink 2
programme.desc: Sisters and the Shrink 2 is a comedy that touches on real-life challenges. The six women try to navigate their lives with their significant others and family but still fall short of the true happines they desire. The shrink is their only hope.

programme.title: Seeds of Satan
programme.desc: The day has came where The Witch has arrived and released the seeds of Satan onto the world. Now the last few survivors must get to the holy grounds with the child of God before it's too late.

programme.title: Ain't God Alright
programme.desc: After losing his job and getting dumped Eugene Middlebrooks has one objective, get a job. The struggling musician finds himself running into a few old and new friends while learning what really matters in life.

programme.title: Daddy
programme.desc: Former ESPN announcer and basketball star Fran Harris takes us inside her unique, sometimes tumultuous relationship with her father.

programme.title: Gimme Five
programme.desc: Gimme Five is a show that aims to make the ultimate Top 5 list in music, movies, sports and any other category you can imagine! Host BT Kingsley along with four of his comedian friends debate as they create their top five list fantasy draft style.

programme.title: The Merry Widow
programme.desc: A prince must woo the now-wealthy dancer he once abandoned to keep her money in the country, in order to keep it from crashing economically.

programme.title: Millie
programme.desc: In Prohibition-era New York, vivacious Millie Dillmount arrives with dreams of marrying wealth. Plans take an unexpected turn, leading her through a maze of speakeasies, romance, and high-society secrets.

programme.title: Fog Island
programme.desc: A strange assembly of people gathers together at an island mansion where they begin to suspect one another of murder.

programme.title: The Murder Clinic
programme.desc: A strange physician and his bevy of pretty nurses run a clinic for the mentally ill in a gloomy forest, and staff and patients alike are hunted by a hooded killer.

programme.title: Stage Door Canteen
programme.desc: Dakota Smith, a young soldier on a pass in New York City, visits the famed Stage Door Canteen and hosts a recreational center for servicemen during the war. Dakota meets a pretty young hostess, and they enjoy the many entertainers and a growing romance.

programme.title: The House in Marsh Road
programme.desc: A novelist and his lover Sandra plot to kill his wife, Patricia, to inherit her fortune and property; a watchful ghost in their house protects Patricia and foils their attempted murder plans.

programme.title: Girl Shy
programme.desc: Harold is a shy bachelor working in a tailor shop, writing a guidebook for young men. Fate has him meet a rich girl, and they fall in love. She is about to wed an already-married man, so our hero embarks on a ride to prevent the wedding.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: While traveling in continental Europe, a wealthy young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

programme.title: Satan Claus
programme.desc: With the clock ticking and the body count rising, Homicide Detective Timothy Reynolds reluctantly volunteers to assist his former partner, Detective Alan Fryer, with the investigation to a slew of grisly murders left behind by a mission orientated killer during the Christmas holidays.

programme.title: Beware the Boogeyman
programme.desc: Dr. Tristian Mackenzie makes her way to a Psychiatric Hospital for the criminally insane, where she learns of the strange series of cases from Dr. Moon.

programme.title: The Edison Death Machine
programme.desc: Thought only to exist in legend, Edison's device for contacting the dead is found...and stolen. A group of professional thieves go on a global crime spree reanimating the dead in order to steal treasures thought long lost. Things begin to go wrong when they cannot control the creatures, and the machine begins to develop a mind of its own.

programme.title: Death of A Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Based on true events, a ghost hunter Carter Simms is paid to conduct a paranormal investigation of a suspected haunted house. Along with a cameraman, a reporter, and a spiritual advocate, she embarks on a three night journey into terror.

programme.title: Chain of Souls
programme.desc: When a naive aspiring actress from Podunk, Texas disappears in Los Angeles, her protective sister comes looking for her. The clues lead her to a diabolical cult masquerading as a theater group and the fight of her life.

programme.title: Infliction
programme.desc: In 2011, two brothers documented their murder spree in North Carolina. This is the actual assembled footage.

programme.title: Blood Punch
programme.desc: A young man breaks out of rehab to follow a mysterious girl into an easy drug score. But when she lures him to an isolated cabin, their simple love triangle quickly descends into a mind-blowing cycle of carnage and mayhem with no escape.

programme.title: Dirty Conscience
programme.desc: A cop thriller from Chile.Two young police recruits are assigned a tough, decorated Officer to train them. It quickly becomes clear that their new boss is involved with serious corruption. At first the two young cops try to look the other way. But as their boss begins to doubt their loyalty, the two recruits must choose between saving their honor and their careers--before their boss has them killed.

programme.title: Beyond the Night
programme.desc: When a soldier's son reveals damning information about a local gangster's missing daughter, a war of attrition wreaks havoc on their forgotten coal mining town.

programme.title: Haunted Boat
programme.desc: HAUNTED BOAT is a mystical, mind-twisting psychological horror film about six teenagers going on a boat trip and getting lost in parallel dimensions where they have to face their greatest fears.

programme.title: Insidious Inferno
programme.desc: A secluded cottage is plagued by a series of gruesome murders, unbeknownst to the inhabitants something other worldly lurks within the halls.

programme.title: Point of Fear
programme.desc: When Mark, Parker, Melissa, and Karen decide to go camping in the small town of Pleasant Point, they find the town has much to offer... including a string of brutal murders.

programme.title: Almost Invisible
programme.desc: Be captured by the Invisible. To ease the weight of their college workload, unsuspecting teenagers seize the opportunity to to turn their end-of-the-summer party, into a sick, house wrecking.

programme.title: Holistay
programme.desc: Two couples, who do not know each other, double book a vacation house in San Diego and strange events begin to happen. "Things are not as they appear."

programme.title: Antisocial Behaviour
programme.desc: Jakob Kelser is a man with a horrific, troubled past. Having been failed by society and plagued by a gruesome childhood memory, he is forced to live alone in the unholy hell of God's making.

programme.title: Pillow Party Massacre
programme.desc: Haunted by a prank gone fatally wrong, five friends reunite to heal. But not all can forget, and it's clear that someone or something is out for revenge.

programme.title: Weekend Killer
programme.desc: Detective's Joey Moretti and Patricia Stevens are trying to track down a serial killer that preys on young attractive women, leaving only cryptic messages carved into their flesh as clues! Joey struggles to keep himself together as the investigation leads him closer and closer to the deranged killer!

programme.title: The Faith Community
programme.desc: A group of religious students drive into the remote wilderness to spend time with a religious sect and strengthen their bond with God. The three unsuspecting students film everything to document their experience but soon find themselves in the dark.

programme.title: A Gun for Jennifer
programme.desc: A woman comes to New York City from Ohio to escape an abusive husband and gets entangled with murderous female vigilantes who prey on abusive men.

programme.title: Cut Her Out
programme.desc: Darcy can't purge her mind of the animalistic abuse she suffered as a child at the hands of her mother. Darcy's therapist Ryan discovers that her family homestead has been abandoned.

programme.title: Death Mask
programme.desc: Wilbur works in an old carnival and shows some gruesome things to the puplic. He covered his face because he had a sadistic father who burned his face. Everybody makes jokes about his scars and when the new boss fired him, he go to an old swamp-witch who gives him a peace of wood from a hanging tree and Wilbur makes a mask from this piece of wood and put all his anger in this mask. When he puts the mask on, everybody who looks on this mask commits suicide. He has created the Death-Mask.

programme.title: Hunting Season
programme.desc: Tom Sizemore and Eric Roberts in this tense thriller about two FBI agents who track down a missing person's case which leads them to a group of stock brokers who hunt people for sport.

programme.title: Temptation
programme.desc: A beautiful, young woman out on the town with friends is saved from the clutches of a serial rapist by an ancient but gorgeous vampire, but at what cost?

programme.title: The Minx
programme.desc: Linnea Chiang is a mild-mannered tobacconist by day and a masked master thief by night; like some modern day Robin Hood, the black vinyl-clad "Minx" robs large corporations and gives the money away to homeless people on the streets of Chicago.

programme.title: Exorcism in Utero
programme.desc: Herma finds a powerful ring that possesses her when she tries it on. As her body transforms and mind begins to deteriorate, she must find a way out to save herself and her unborn baby.

programme.title: South Beach Classics
programme.desc: Need a classic car? If you're in Miami, where old-time autos fit in perfectly with the city's glitz and glamour, Ted Vernon is the man to see. The no-nonsense, gregarious Long Islander runs Florida's largest classic car dealership, where he buys, sells, trades and exchanges unique cars from a lot that houses more than 300 of them. His outgoing personality meshes seamlessly with the colourful collectibles he moves each day, helped by an eclectic shop crew affectionately dubbed `the gargoyles'.

programme.title: South Beach Classics
programme.desc: Ted, being the original character he is, charmed and negotiated his way around the Midwest, the Northeast, and throughout the Central and Southern American states, buying and selling Classic Cars in the only way he knows how: by haggling and wheeling and dealing.

programme.title: Titans of Business
programme.desc: There have been many stories and documentaries on the Bill Gates’, Steve Jobs’ and Henry Fords’ of the world. What about the thousands of other business people, that had a better idea or way to make life better, cheaper, and faster? People who started out from meager beginnings or limited education, to become very wealthy! Many of these people are among us and act no differently than we do, but they have a success story to tell and tricks of success to share. These are the people profiled in “Titans of Business”.

programme.title: Inside Vienna - Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports
programme.desc: Welcome to Vienna!Austria’s capital, lying by the Danube River and known for its artistic and intellectual legacy shaped by residents as Mozart, Beethoven or Sigmund Freud amongst others. Vienna is a city known for its tradition, but has also become the scene for modern nautical sports that are shifting the world of water sports.From meeting the Austrian Olympic rowing team to freestyle kayaking and a rendezvous with the local Gondola Club, host Lucia Metzbauer is on a quest to discover the nautical sports and athletes of Vienna. She is set for a challenge as she sails across all the different sport options in the city.Become part of the Vienna scenery and discover the water sports this city has to offer from the side of Lucia Metzbauer, on Inside Vienna – Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit Of Yachting - Ep.2 - Rolex TP52 World Championship
International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom World Cup Markkleeberg
programme.desc: Markkleeberg, in Germany, is home to the Pleisse River that runs through the city. Known for merging several towns over the years, it now combines the best athletes who compete in the Slalom World Cup.Watch the most extreme canoe slalom that will decide the world champion in this unique 2021 Markkleeberg competition.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom World Cup Prague
programme.desc: Prague hosts the 2021 Slalom World Cup, and the top class athletes are getting ready for a weekend full of action. They will have to pass through a combination of upstream and downstream gates in the fastest time possible, however the competition will prove to be hard as only the best will be in this event.Watch the Slalom World Cup competition that is taking place in Prague.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 1
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is back! The World Sailing foiling catamaran circuit has returned as the world recovers from COVID, and both teams and organizers have been keen to return to racing onboard their state-of-the-art flying catamarans. After 18 months of no racing and cancelled events, the anticipation going into the first event in Lagos, Portugal is huge!After a highly competitive, spectacular 2019 season the GC32 foiling cats are back on the racecourse. In 2021, the ultra-high performance one-design catamarans will visit 3 top venues for 4 events, each location selected specially to provide conditions ideal for the nimble GC32s to fly across the water at 30+ knot speeds.So, let’s travel to Lagos, in southern Portugal's Algarve region to witness the first GC32 Racing Tour event for 2021, Lagos Cup 1.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP Italy - Ski
Sailing To Tokyo - Episode 4
programme.desc: In this month's episode we move to the western edge of Europe and the second largest city of Portugal, Porto. Located alongside the stunning Douro River, Porto is home ot the 2019 Laser Senior European Championships and Open European Trophy with all the top names of the class. Also, new ambitious senior sailors are on their way to the titles.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Ep7 - Kayaking Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Ken Whiting kayaks along Northern Ireland\'s Giant\'s Causeway Coast near Derry and Strangford Lough outside Belfast.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 1
programme.desc: Our DJ adventure is about to begin! Come with us as we pack our bags and leave for sunny Ibiza in Spain. After dropping our bags we are saying hi to David Guetta before trying out our skills as DJs and finding out how Ibiza's nightlife will surprise us. Join us!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 2
programme.desc: Sailing Deejay continues its journey in Ibiza and the nearing islands to the rhythm of the night! Sam and Max are getting on more adventures, and while they sail during the day they party and DJ during the night! When will they get a chance to sleep and rest a bit? Let's get the party started, on Nautical Channel!

Appropriately coinciding with the Olympic Games, the event included some of the sailing's leading names, including several multiple Olympic medallists.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - Preview
Surf Series: South Africa - Episode 1
programme.desc: South Africa has some of the best and most consistent surf breaks in the world but the qualifying series, for years, lacked events there. This year competitive surfing is back in South Africa and the season returned with a bang, with five QS Events ranging from 1 star, to 3 star, before culminating at the 6 star Ballito Pro. Let's reflect on the highlights of 2017.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.9 - OPATIJA - IČIĆI - MOSĆENIČKA DRAGA
Dis.Traction
programme.desc: The two-time world wave sailing champion Marcilio Browne, originally from Brazil, has decided to make the Hawaiian island of Maui his permanent home to pursue his passion. Dis.Traction follows Marcilio during his first training sessions leading into to the decisive season’s final contest where the greatest windsurfers compete for the ultimate prize.Following the end of contest season, Marcilio and fellow wave sailing champion Morgan Noireaux take to the mountains, or rather to the volcano for some alternative action. As the island is exposed to heavy ground swells from many directions, Marcilio and his friends are always looking for ideal spots to practice.Dis.Traction is a rollercoaster ride of action and an authentic insight into the perspective of a seasoned professional windsurfer. Shot on location it features the breathtaking beauty of the Hawaiian Island of Maui and showcases appearances of some of the sport’s greatest athletes.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep7 - Stockholm
The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.
